test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following groups consists of only output devices?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plotter, printer and monitor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Output devices** are hardware components of a computer that convey information from the computer to the user or to another device.
 
• The **monitor** is a screen that displays visual output from the computer.
 
• A **printer** produces a hard copy (physical output) of documents, images, or graphics from the computer.
 
• **Function**: A plotter is used to produce high-quality graphics, drawings, and blueprints.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Input devices allow users to p**rovide data and commands to the computer.**
 
• **Input Devices: **Keyboard, Mouse, Touchscreen, Scanner, Microphone, Webcam, Game Controller, Joystick, Graphics Tablet, Barcode Reader.
 
• Output devices present processed **data from the computer to the user or to another system.**
 
• **Output Devices**: Monitor, Printer, Plotter, Speakers, Projector, Headphones, LCD Display, LED Display, Braille Display, Virtual Reality Headset.
